_comment: Used by the Code node in n8n/workflows/01-main-input-handler.json (node: Compare Text vs Vision) to decide match/mismatch/warning status when a proof photo is attached.

notes.absoluteToleranceIDR: Allowed flat IDR difference between text-stated nominal and photo-extracted nominal (covers small admin/transfer fees) before flagging a mismatch.
notes.percentTolerance: Allowed relative difference (2%) as an alternative check for larger transactions where a flat IDR tolerance would be too strict.
notes.dateDiffDaysWarnOnly: If nominal matches but the transaction date differs by up to this many days, proceed with a warning annotation instead of blocking on a mismatch clarification.
